parts.text: The tales survive in two important Welsh-language manuscripts. First, in Llyfr Gwyn Rhydderch (the White Book of Rhydderch),

around the mid-14th century, and second in Llyfr Coch Hergest (the Red Book of Hergest), written towards the end of that century.

But the stories themselves are older. They had been transmitted and copied since before

Edward I’s conquest of Wales in 1282, and perhaps as early as the 11th century.

Five of the tales feature Arthur, the legendary warrior whose tales spread throughout all of Europe. The Four Branches of the Mabinogi, are a group of stories

the landscapes of Wales, Ireland and England, of this world and the supernatural otherworld. The remaining two, including The Dream of Macsen Wledig, reshape particular strands of early British history through native

. All the tales offer imaginative accounts of power and political authority.

A Roman emperor in Welsh legend

In The Dream of Macsen Wledig, a Roman emperor falls in love with a woman he sees in a dream. Determined to find her, he sends

to follow the route he has dreamt. Their journey takes them across Europe and eventually to what is now Caernarfon, in north-west Wales.

The emperor is called Macsen Wledig (Macsen the Leader). His character is a literary composite of a

of historical characters, most notably the Galician Magnus Maximus, a Roman general who became Emperor in the late 4th century. Born in a province that is now part of Spain and Portugal, Magnus Maximus

power in Britain and went on to rule much of the western Roman empire, including Gaul (roughly modern France and neighbouring regions).

His legacy in Wales is particularly significant. In the popular Welsh song Yma o Hyd (Still Here), first released in 1983, the

and former politician Dafydd Iwan invokes Magnus Maximus’ departure from Britain, supposedly leaving Wales behind as an entire nation.

The song draws on a powerful literary tradition – that the departure of Rome from Britain, just before the

of the English, saw the birth of Welsh identity.

But the medieval story is not a straightforward account of historical events. Like the song, it blends historical memory with imagination. Its importance lies not simply in whether every detail is
accurate, but in what the story tells us about how Welsh people understood the past.

questions.evidence: Its importance lies not simply in whether every detail is factually accurate, but in what the story tells us about how Welsh people understood the past.

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Achieving a goal can produce emptiness, revealing limits of achievement as a source of fulfilment.
The discovery of a Roman fort revives interest in an emperor's place in Welsh tradition.
Horror filmmakers exploit features of human vision to create frightening effects.
Ancient disputes over mapmaking illuminate debates about how the world is represented.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: The recent discovery of a Roman timber fort in the Preseli hills of Pembrokeshire, south-west Wales, has brought a medieval Welsh legend into fresh focus.

questions.prompt: How is The Dream of Macsen Wledig situated in Welsh literature?
options: It has no connection with medieval Welsh storytelling.
It is the first printed computer game.
It is a modern scientific laboratory manual.
It is one of eleven tales traditionally grouped as the Mabinogion.
questions.explanation: 第 3 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: The Dream of Macsen Wledig is one of the 11 medieval Welsh-language tales traditionally grouped together as the Mabinogion.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 8?
options: The Dream of Macsen Wledig is one of the 11 medieval Welsh-language tales traditionally grouped together as the Mabinogion.
Five of the tales feature Arthur, the legendary warrior whose tales spread throughout all of Europe.
These tales blend history, folklore, magic and legend, while some people see in them lost myths.
In The Dream of Macsen Wledig, a Roman emperor falls in love with a woman he sees in a dream.
questions.explanation: 定位第 8 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: In The Dream of Macsen Wledig, a Roman emperor falls in love with a woman he sees in a dream.
